title: Reaction–Diffusion Tie-Dye
blurb: Gray–Scott chemistry grows coral, worms, mazes and dividing spots on the GPU, folded into a slowly turning kaleidoscope and dyed with cycling cosine palettes; drag to pour in catalyst.
controls: Drag to paint catalyst, pick a regime (or let it drift through all of them, or show the whole parameter map), palette, speed, symmetry folds, colour spin and bands; Reseed, Pause, Record; H hides UI, R records, Space reseeds
tech: WebGL2 fragment shaders, float ping-pong textures
